concept.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production concept art and in-game chapter vista for a Brazilian comic adventure game expansion called Império da Delícia.
Primary request: a magnificent sprawling tropical island powered by orange juice, designed with the craftsmanship of a lovingly hand-built animated feature miniature. Establish a coherent, highly detailed new world for exploration.
Scene: wide cinematic aerial three-quarter view of an enormous crescent-shaped island. Lower left: a bustling cream sandstone fishing village with terracotta roofs, orange-striped awnings, piers, sailboats, orange crates, market square and an open-hand fountain. Left highland: lush irregular citrus terraces, flowering orange trees with visible fruit, footpaths, root sanctuary, windmills. Centre: towering dramatic honey sandstone canyon, five magnificent waterfalls of luminous orange juice, a spectacular multi-level aqueduct spanning the chasm, hanging wooden walkways, ancient mosaic amphitheatre around a large chalice-shaped source. Upper right: a formidable yet whimsical teal-and-brass juice refinery climbing a steep mountain, glass reservoirs, orange pipelines, cogs, pulley lifts and balconies. Summit: Paulo Guina's purple-bannered baronial citadel with a segmented orange-dome observatory, grand stairs, fluted towers and huge mechanical citrus press. A tiny secluded forbidden garden and a bell tower are distinct discoveries. Beautiful turquoise ocean, foam, offshore rocks, warm haze.
Style: high-end stylized 3D game art, hand-painted material textures, sculpted silhouettes, tactile carved limestone, oxidized turquoise copper, warm brass, creamy foam, verdant foliage. Crisp architecture and landscape, varied visual rhythm, grounded believable structures and functional connections. Every area has a distinct landmark and clear navigable route. Warm late-afternoon golden sunlight from upper left, cool teal shadows. Rich but restrained saturation.
Composition: landscape 3:2, full island visible with a modest ocean border, long diagonal ascent from welcoming harbour to oppressive palace. Strong depth and large physical scale, impressive vertical cliffs; not a flat board. No text, no logos, no UI, no humans in foreground, no literal commercial brand references.

enemies.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production enemy sprite atlas for the 2D action platform game Império da Delícia.
Primary request: EXACTLY eight separate full-body little enemy character sprites in a precise 4-column by 2-row grid. Every sprite centered within its own equally sized cell, separated by generous completely transparent space. Orthographic side-to-three-quarter game camera, all facing left, feet aligned near lower quarter of each cell. Uniform scale, uniform lighting from upper left.
Style: exquisite stylized miniature 3D sculpture with hand-painted material finish, charming expressive faces, crisp readable silhouettes, warm highlights and cool teal shadows. Orange-juice factory and citrus orchard theme. Muted sandstone, vibrant orange flesh, verdigris teal, dark wood, antique brass. No outlines, no realism, no words, no grid lines, no floor or cast shadows.
Top row left to right: (1) a plump mischievous living orange-pulp blob, citrus segments and a little leaf crest, stubby arms, two small feet, expressive eyes; (2) a six-legged forest beetle with segmented green orange-leaf shell, visible antennae, orange belly; (3) a flying citrus wasp with translucent scalloped wings, orange striped body, tiny brass stinger, mischievous eyes; (4) a brass cog-wheel rolling automaton with a single orange glass eye and little leaf-shaped metal spikes.
Bottom row left to right: (5) a stocky brass and teal sentry robot with round orange-glass chest, broad armored shoulders, sturdy jointed legs, hinged helmet and expressive eye slit; (6) a bottle-shaped juice-launcher automaton with transparent amber juice tank, cork nozzle nose, teal mechanical legs and brass pressure gauge; (7) a wooden barrel mimic with a clearly hinged open toothed lid, two luminous eyes, curled vine feet and brass hoops; (8) a small orange-flower plant turret with thick green leaves and a trumpet-shaped orange blossom nozzle, rooted in a chipped cream ceramic pot.
All eight must be fully visible with no cropped limbs or wing tips, no overlap between sprites. Genuinely transparent RGBA background.
